jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Description
General information:

The Project Execution team is at the heart of our organization, meeting and exceeding customer expectations while helping to build a sustainable and profitable future. You will lead projects within the Transformers Business Unit.

Reporting to the Project Operations Manager you will maintain and enhance customer satisfaction by providing excellent service at all stages of the project.

The role is to be executed in our office in Cordoba (Spain).

Responsibilities:
• Leading the project team with clear guidelines, tasks and milestones, while motivating and providing feedback.
• Managing all aspects of the project to agreed-upon customer requirements and ensuring all technical, safety, quality and financial targets are met.
• Overseeing the development of project plan documents in relation to scope, budget, schedule, and risk management.
• Monitoring each stage of project implementation to ensure best practices in cost control, resource efficiency, risk... management and health, safety and the environment. Identifying, analyzing and addressing project risks, with the regular sharing of lessons learned.
• Coordinating contract negotiation and claims with customers, in collaboration with the Supply Chain and Legal functions.
• Achieving project deliverables and compliance with contract requirements.
• Building strong relationships with customers and stakeholders.
• Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background:
• A bachelor's degree in Engineering.
• More than 3 years of experience in Project Management, in a multinational environment.
• Demonstrated experience in management of project scope, cost, schedules and vendors/subcontractor Customer oriented, with excellent organization and strong communication skills.
• Fluent in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
• Current work permit valid in Spain.
• Knowledge of SAP
• French language and a PMI certification will be considered a plus

jobs_results.title: CX Project Manager (TIP2024)
jobs_results.description:
Are you a fresh graduate looking to boost your career in a dynamic and innovative multinational?

Join our Talent Incubator Program and start your career journey at Schneider Electric!

Who we are and what we do.

In Schneider Electric, we are the leading digital partner in sustainability and efficiency for businesses, communities, and individuals. Our goal is for everyone to be able to make the most of our energy and resources through the integration of processes, software, Big Data, and cutting-edge energy technologies that enable integrated management of buildings, industries, and cities.

We are part of the TOP5 in the ranking of the best companies to work for in Spain 2023, present in over 110 countries with a diverse and disruptive team of over 135,000 people.

What You Can Expect.

We have created an innovative program including many learning, training, and disruptive experiences, with tailored content regarding sustainability and digital transformation, and focusing on... launching your professional career with us.

From the first day 1 an Agile, Transformative, and Inspiring program awaits you, where you’ll combine your work hands-on work experience (being actively integrated into the day-to-day activities of your teams) with training and mentoring, and the development of a project sponsored by a member of our management committee.

We are looking for people like you, who are willing to embrace this challenge and develop the potential you have within.

Position title: CX Project Manager

Where will you work?

CS&Q is responsible for managing and improving every interaction throughout a customer's journey with Schneider. This includes understanding the customer's needs, preferences, and pain points throughout their journey, and then designing, implementing, and monitoring strategies and initiatives to enhance our overall customer experience. It also involves ensuring that products or services meet established standards and customer expectations.

This position is crucial for aligning customer experience initiatives with the company's strategic objectives. Collaborating closely with various teams and leaders provides the opportunity to influence decision-making processes that directly impact customer perception and satisfaction. Understanding customer needs and preferences enables advocating for customer-centric solutions that not only enhance the overall customer experience but also drive business growth, customer retention, and long-term loyalty. Additionally, ensuring that products or services meet established standards and customer expectations through processes to identify, address, and prevent issues in order to maintain high quality standards.

What will you do?
• Gathering and analyzing customer feedback and data to identify areas for improvement; Developing and implementing customer-centric processes across various touchpoints; Collaborating with other departments to ensure a consistent and seamless customer experience; Sharing and promoting global customer experience programs within the organization;
• Measuring and sharing customer satisfaction KPIs with the organization;
• Driving initiatives to increase customer satisfaction, retention, and value;
• Implementing corrective actions when issues are identified;
• Communicating with customers about problems and solutions;
• Training staff in quality practices;
• Advocating for the customer within the organization to ensure their needs are prioritized in decision-making.

What will you learn?

This position will allow you to develop a holistic understanding of customer experience, business, and strategic alignment, while enhancing your interpersonal and professional skills.

Communication: Improving communication skills through interactions with diverse teams, leaders, and customers. Strategic Thinking: Learning to align customer experience initiatives with the company's strategic objectives and contribute to decision-making processes. Customer-Centric Mindset: Understanding and advocating for customer needs, preferences, and solutions. Collaboration: Working closely with different teams and leaders to influence customer perception and satisfaction. Business Acumen: Gaining insights into how customer experience impacts business growth, customer retention, and long-term loyalty.

What You Bring:
• Fresh graduate in Management or Engineering
• Be able to start a 1-year program in May 2024.
• Fluent in English and Spanish, written and spoken. Portuguese is a plus.
• Analytical skills and intermediate level of Excel (Basic – Pivots and formulas, Macros - is a plus).
• Basic/intermediate level in Power Point. Knowledge of Agile methodologies and Design Thinking is a plus.
• Collaborative and curious, Active listening, Problem-solving skills, and innovative. Empathy and proactivity.

What we offer?

· An open-ended contract with a very competitive compensation package

· A unique experience specially designed for your learning and development

· The opportunity to meet others talented workers colleagues and develop your network around through activities and bootcamps

· The development of a Game Changer project with Agile methodologies.

· Depending on the position, rotations into different teams inside or outside of your department for 1 month or more

· Careers opportunities

What is the application process?

Step 1 – Online Application

Step 2 - Online recorded video interview

Step 3 – Online Competencies test

Step 4 – Online Escape Room

Step 5 - Online Interview

Places are filled on a first-come, first-served basis. We would recommend early application to avoid disappointment!.

Benefits.
• We adapt to you! :
• With our flexible schedule, you'll have the freedom to adjust your working hours to accommodate your personal needs and responsibilities.

💻 We understand the benefits of working from home. With our hybrid work plan, you can enjoy working hours from the comfort of your own home.

🏝 Need more time to relax and unwind? With our Holy Pack, you can purchase additional vacation days to recharge whenever you need it most.

📅 Celebrate holidays your way! With Floating Holidays, you can exchange public holidays for other days that better suit your plans and personal preferences.

🧘‍♂️ Need extra time to explore new experiences or focus on personal projects? With the Sabbatical Pack, you can request up to 2 months of additional unpaid leave.

💞 We value the importance of family and want to support you in all aspects of your life. Our Global Family Leave Policy provides flexible paid conditions for when you need it most, whether you're about to become a parent, need time to overcome a loss, or care for a loved one.

· We take care of you! :

📱 With access to the health and wellness platform Wellwo, you and up to 5 people of your choice can enjoy virtual medical care and 24/7 psychological support, as well as access to nutritional advice, guided classes, and much more!

🏄‍♂️ From attending dance classes to booking a hotel spa, we offer a partnership with AJ by Gympass, giving you access to a network of thousands of gyms and sports centers, so you can keep your body active in the way you prefer.

🩺 Your well-being is our priority. You'll have medical services available at your workplace for close attention to any medical needs.

· We empower you! :

🎯 With Open Talent Market, our AI-driven professional development platform, you can connect with job opportunities, projects, and mentors at Schneider Electric globally.

🤑 We offer you the opportunity to become a shareholder of Schneider Electric and share in our achievements through our employee share ownership program.

🙌 We celebrate talent and success offor all with our recognition program, where you can give and receive points for your accomplishments and redeem them for gift cards at your favorite stores.

💗 You'll have life insurance for your protection.

💰 We offer a Flexible Compensation Plan, where you can choose from a variety of options such as health insurance, meal vouchers, childcare vouchers, transportation vouchers, training, and more.

🛒 As part of our #SEGreatPeople, you'll have access to an online store with Schneider Electric products at exclusive prices and super discounts.

🎁 With Club Schneider, you'll enjoy special discounts at your favorite stores, restaurants, travel agencies, and other external services.

💚 Participate in company-sponsored volunteer programs to contribute to our community and make a positive impact in your surroundings.

Disclaimer
• We seek out and reward people for putting the customer first, being disruptingve to the status quo, embracing different perspectives, continuously learning, and acting like owners. We want our employees to reflect the diversity of the communities in which we operate. We welcome people as they are, creating an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity are seen as a real value for the company. We’re looking for people with a passion for success — on the job and beyond

Why us?

Schneider Electric is leading the digital transformation of energy management and automation. Our technologies enable the world to use energy in a safe, efficient and sustainable manner. We strive to promote a global economy that is both ecologically viable and highly productive.

€25.7bn global revenue

137 000+ employees in 100+ countries

45% of revenue from IoT

5% of revenue devoted for R&D

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled

It is the policy of Schneider Electric to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities in the areas of recruiting, hiring, training, transferring, and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, color, gender, disability, national origin, ancestry, age, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic or conduct. Concerning agencies: Schneider Electric does not accept unsolicited resumes and will not be responsible for fees related to such

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
At PayRetailers, we are committed to providing cutting-edge solutions that empower businesses to succeed in Latin America. Our collaborative and inclusive work environment encourages creativity and growth, where every employee's contribution is valued. Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with us, as we strive to make a meaningful impact on the world of payments.

We’re searching for a highly qualified professional to help us maintain our position as an innovative authority. The ideal candidate will have Project Portfolio Admin experience and is a highly resourceful Project Manager with background in Financial Services or payments.

To support and guide teams to meet and exceed business objectives ensuring the consistent achievement of all operational KPI’s across the PMO is one of this role goals, our ideal candidate has extreme attention to detail and is driven by excellence.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with project managers to ensure successful planning... execution, monitoring, and closure of projects within PayRetailers.
• Develop and maintain project documentation, including project plans, schedules, and risk management plans.
• Assist in resource allocation, tracking project milestones, and facilitating effective communication among project teams.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for JIRA administration within the PMO.
• Customize JIRA workflows, screens, fields, and reports to meet project management needs.
• Provide training and support to project teams on JIRA best practices, ensuring consistent and effective utilization.
• Communicate effectively in English to ensure clear and concise collaboration with stakeholders, both internal and external.
• Leverage previous PMO experience to contribute insights and best practices to enhance project management processes within PayRetailers.
• Actively contribute to the identification and implementation of process improvements within the PMO, ensuring efficiency and effectiveness.

Experience and Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent work experience
• Minimum of 3 years of experience leading projects (IT, banking, retail or logistics).
• Proficient in project management software tools, methodologies, and best practices JIRA is a plus
• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on reporting
• English is a must
• Experience with Global teams and with time flexibility
• Excellent analytical skills
• Strong interpersonal skills and extremely resourceful
• Excellent presentation skills
• Proven ability to solve problems creatively

What we offer:
• Competitive salary! 💶
• Opportunities to grow within a company in hypergrowth stage📉
• Additional days of holidays! ✈
• Free language classes 👨‍🏫
• Private health insurance covered by the company.🩺
• At least one day of teleworking per week 💻 #LI-Hybrid
• Free catering in the office 🥣
• Possibility to increase your net salary through our flexible retribution partner! 🍕
• Excellent work environment and good collaboration ✌️
• Free coffee/Tea and snacks from the company☕🥐

jobs_results.title: Project Management, Lead Specialist
jobs_results.description:
SUCCESSFACTORS EC-ECP PROJECT MANAGER

The Project Manager is responsible for the successful management of one or more country implementation projects eventually part of a large program with responsibility for delivering a defined section within SuccessFactors environment.

Your responsibilities:

· Manages project deliverables, scope and expectations and coordinates project progress with stakeholders and program management.

· Interfaces independently with all functional and business areas/ groups affected by the project,

· Works closely with Resource Managers to ensure adequate allocation of resources to projects is being managed

· Develops and tracks to detailed project plan, including schedules, cost estimates, resource plans, communication plans, risk mitigation plans and issue resolution plans

· Makes project decisions and recommendations to program management about schedules, prioritization, and resource allocation with input from others as needed

· Communicates and reports... status to program management and all other stakeholders e.g., Status Reports, steering input, etc.

· Provides leadership to his/her project teams

· Employs project management best practice methodologies working within a framework that includes process definition, templates, tools and Alight standards

· Coaches team members to reach common project goals/objectives

· Identifies training needs within his project team

· Managing the project budget – including the estimates created during the funding process, the on-going allocation of financial resources and the regular reporting of the state of the project financials

· Ensuring C-sat meets the agreed target, taking ownership with the AD, to drive improved customer satisfaction at project level

· Monitors the project deliverables are within Alight’s standard delivery model and deviations are identified and reported

· Driving CR’s through changes to agreed standard/contract, mitigating any commercial risk

· Driving improved project performance through continuous improvement and transformation activities

· Working with third party providers to deliver contractual commitments

Your experience:

· At least 4 years’ experience in IT-project management with background within SAP payroll implementation or SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll

· Certification in at least two SuccessFactors modules

· Willingness to travel

· Vendor management experience

· Fluent in English (written, spoken, …)

· Experience within the HR-domain

· Ideally PMP certification or similar (PRINCE2, Agile, SCRUM,…)

· Ideally HR Consulting and /or outsourcing industry experience

Your skills

· Leadership skills

· Ability to work in a multi-cultural/international environment

· Ability to interpret and prioritize multiple, potentially conflicting requirements

· Excellent presentation and influencing skills

· Strong analytical and problem solving skills

· Strong risk analysis and capacity to develop efficient and effective mitigation plans

· Outcome and target focused

· Highly commercially aware

· Pragmatic approach

· Strong financial acumen and forecast accuracy

· Clear contract understanding and scope management

· Committed to deadlines and schedule in time.

· Lead a team with moderate supervision

· Produce good quality work, delivers technical and analytical results, demonstrates value creation for smaller projects

· Contribute to proposal process independently within specified area

· Ideally leadership experience in implementing specific solutions at various customers

· implemented/led a technology solution through all project phases several times

· Combine methodology to new approaches as a response to customer needs

· Fluent English

We offer you a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

DISCLAIMER:

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job to other entities; including but not limited to subsidiaries, partners, or purchasers of Alight business units.

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Global Business & Management Support
jobs_results.description:
BNP Paribas is an international bank with leading positions in the European market. It is present in 74 countries and employs more than 192,000 people, 146,000 of whom are in Europe. The Group holds key positions in its three main areas of activity: Domestic Markets and International Financial Services (whose retail banking and financial services network is part of Retail Banking & Services), as well as Corporate & Institutional Banking, which offers services to corporate and institutional clients. The Group supports its customers (individuals, entrepreneurs, SMEs, large companies and institutions) to help them carrying out their projects by providing financing, investment, savings and insurance services.
In Europe, the Group has four domestic markets (Belgium, France, Italy and Luxembourg) and BNP Paribas Personal Finance is number one in retail financing in Europe.
BNP Paribas is developing its integrated retail banking model in the Mediterranean countries, Turkey, Eastern Europe... and has an important network on the US West Coast. In both its Corporate & Institutional Banking and International Financial Services activities, BNP Paribas has leading positions in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas and a solid and growing network in the Asia-Pacific region.

BNP Paribas in its Securities Services business offers a wide range of services derived from the purchase and sale of financial instruments and units in investment funds, such as their settlement, custody, valuation, administration and financing and all financial transactions derived therefrom (dividend payments, capital increases, fund subscriptions and redemptions, etc.).

The objective of the Global Client Development management is to grow strategic clients while developing best-in-class Client Development team over the world. Their ambition is:
• To develop a portfolio of strategic opportunities in partnership with Global Head of Commercial Strategy and Marketing, across Regions and Locations,
• To ensure that local sales set-up is aligned with the objectives
• To lead the definition of new sales and retention targets
• To provide support for complex deals, in strong coordination with the Regional Managers
• To coach the Regional Sales Leaders to maximize new business opportunities
• To ensure CD community is up-to-date with CD documentation and training (guidelines, procedures, usage of the internal tools, product management, best practices, etc)
• To ensure that best practices & tools are shared and rolled out at Regional level

This team is counting 2 people dedicated to animate communities of more than 200 Global relationship managers and global sales over the world.

MISSION:

Purpose

This is a role to provide support to the business and the CD community/ the Client Development Exco
• Deliver proper reporting to monitor performance over the regions ensuring continuous improvement
• Lead the preparation of all sales presentations, campaign material, management and ad-hoc reporting
• Articulate and develop strategic presentations to the senior management
• Supporting the standardisation of reporting across jurisdictions
• Participate into definition and animation of organisation & governance for the Client development Unit
• Coordinate and promote collaboration of projects assigned
• Conduct in all missions and studies assigned
• Ensure that the business process run smoothly, providing business support when required
• Be aware of transversal initiatives impacting evolutions in CRM tool and establish a reliable communication with the teams.
• Develop and maintain updated the Client Development knowledge base, by documenting every existing process, change, evolution, etc

Scope

Securities Services Client Development worldwide

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business performance monitoring and analysis
• Ensure regular delivery of existing reports and dashboards while working on its continuous improvement
• Provide MPI and Analysis on all dimensions of the Commercial performance
• Support monitoring of ad-hoc campaigns and transversal and produce specific reports to complete global dashboards
• Ensure the data quality of the reporting by ensuring a diligent data recording and tracking
• Consolidate updates and information and conduct the proper study & analysis in order to support to management in the decision making process
• Prepare ad-hoc reporting & assist management, when required and ad -hoc.

Business and Management Support
• Work with key stakeholders on regular and/or ad hoc basis to ensure the continued development of high quality outcome and deliveries
• Ensure coordination of the key sales campaigns, transversal and CD global initiatives
• Support the effective use of tools and best practices across Locations
• Ensure the documentation is up to date and comprehensible for all CD Community (guidelines, procedures and internal documentation)
• Support and where required act as designate on all major internal and external committees
• Articulate and develop strategic presentations to the senior management
• Collect information
• Organise messages
• Build and develop presentation

Definition & animation of organisation & governance
• Elaborate content supporting Governance
• Manage follow up and action plans
• Act as designate at select key committees

Leading and Coordination of transversal initiatives and projects across the CD community team as required
• Act as coordinator for projects assigned
• Propose and develop relevant documents and databases to record project information and ensure oversight
• Develop proactive relationships with stakeholders to ensure project progress and delivery
• Ensure reporting to management and adequate communication

Key internal stakeholders:
• Global Head of CD
• CD Exco members
• CD Enablement & Transformation team
• CD COO Community
• Business Performance Practice team
• CD team managers and team members across the world
• Location and regional Heads
• Oher business métiers (eg.FIC)

Key external key stakeholders:
• Event stakeholders
• Client & Consultant engagement as required

REQUIREMENTS:

Training:

• Economy, ADE

Experience:

• Knowledge and a background in Client Development as well as CIB is a plus

Languages:

• English:Fluent
SKILLS:

Technical:

• Proven Advanced skills in Office and specifically Excel & PowerPoint
• Strong Analytical skills
• Knowledge and a background in Client Development

Trasversal & Behavioral:

• Communication skills
• Ability to deliver/Results driven
• Ability to collaborate/Teamwork

BENEFITS:

• Training programs, career plans and internal mobility opportunities, national and international thanks to our presence in different countries.
• Diversity and Inclusion Committee that ensures an inclusive work environment. In recent years, several employee communities have been created to organize diversity and inclusion awareness actions (PRIDE, We Generations and MixCity).
• Corporate volunteering program (1 Million Hours 2 Help) in which employees can dedicate time out of their working hours to volunteer activities.
• Flexible compensation plan
• Hybrid telecommuting model (50%)
• 34 vacation days

Diversity and Inclusion commitment

BNP Paribas Group in Spain is an equal opportunity employer and proud to provide equal employment opportunity to all job seekers. We are actively committed to ensuring that no individual is discriminated against on the grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy and maternity/paternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. Equity and diversity are at the core of our recruitment policy because we believe that they foster creativity and efficiency, which in turn increase performance and productivity. We strive to reflect the society we live in, while keeping with the image of our clients

jobs_results.title: Manager - Product engineering team
jobs_results.description:
Multiverse Computing

Multiverse is a well-funded and fast-growing deep-tech company founded in 2019. We are one of the few companies working with Quantum Computing and the biggest Quantum Software company in the EU.

We provide hyper-efficient software to companies wanting to gain an edge with quantum computing and artificial intelligence. Our product, Singularity, is a software platform that contains quantum and quantum-inspired algorithms developed and patented through proof-of-concept trials we have been performing for industrial and service clients. We work in finance, energy, manufacturing, cybersecurity and many more industries.

You will be working alongside world leading experts to build solutions that tackle real life issues. We look for passionate people that want to grow in an ethics driven environment, promoting sustainability and diversity. We aim to continue building our truly inclusive culture - come and join us!
As a Manager - Product engineering team... (Optimization/Machine learning) you will
• Lead an international team of engineers to develop cutting-edge solutions to the hardest industry problems for our top-tier clients.
• Lead the technical direction of complex projects, designing a technical solution to the problem and ensuring the quality of the approach and technology used.
• Manage technical projects from initiation to completion, defining the project scope, objectives, and deliverables. To achieve this, you will:
• Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, resource allocation, and risk assessments.
• Identify and manage project risks, developing contingency plans to address unforeseen obstacles and maintain project momentum.
• Lead and motivate a diverse team of professionals, providing guidance and direction to ensure project goals are met efficiently and effectively, fostering a collaborative and results-driven team environment.
• Monitor project performance and take proactive measures to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.
• Develops documentation, monitors and reports project status, assesses the effectiveness and accuracy of documentation.
• Foster clear and transparent communication channels with stakeholders, team members, and senior management to provide updates on project status, milestones, and potential challenges.
• Collaborate and communicate with other project managers and leaders to coordinate cross-project initiatives and activities.
• Demonstrates an understanding of customer's tactical goals and effectively participates in the development and implementation of business solutions.
• Contribute to the tech strategy providing clients and technology insights

Required Qualifications
• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Data Science, Operations Research, or related field.
• 4+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, data science, IT and/or other relevant engineering domains.
• 1+ year of successful project management experience in leading and managing engineering teams in a technology-driven company.
• Strong understanding of AI technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, or computer vision; or mathematical optimization.
• Excellent command of Python, Docker and Git.
• Experience with GitHub/Gitlab workflows and functionalities.
• Solid understanding of agile development methodologies and best practices.
• Excellent leadership skills with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams effectively.
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal abilities to foster collaboration and maintain strong client relationships.
• Solid organizational and time-management skills, coupled with a keen eye for detail.
• Fluency with English and Spanish.

Preferred Qualifications
• PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Data Science, Operations Research, or related field.
• Experience with quantum computing and/or Tensor Networks libraries.

Perks & Benefits
• Indefinite contract.
• Equal pay guaranteed.
• Variable performance bonus.
• Signing bonus.
• Relocation package (if applicable).
• Opportunity to be part of the phantom shares programme.
• Private health insurance.
• Eligibility for educational budget according to internal policy.
• Hybrid opportunity.
• Flexible working hours.
• Language classes and discounted lunch options
• Working in a high paced environment, working on cutting edge technologies.
• Career plan. Opportunity to learn and teach.
• Progressive Company. Happy people culture

jobs_results.title: Strategic Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
We are offering a Strategic Project Manager in our Madrid office, to build the global contextual advertising leader.

WHO WE ARE

Seedtag is the leading Contextual Advertising Platform. Our proprietary, machine learning-based technology provides a human-like understanding of the content on the web, the highest level of brand safety in the industry and unmatched cookieless targeting capabilities.

We engage with the market on both the demand and supply sides to create, activate and launch high-quality advertising campaigns at scale. We are committed to creating a more beautiful, respectful and engaging way to do advertising.

KEY FIGURES

2014 · Founded by two ex-Googlers

2021 · Fundraising round of 40M€ & +10 countries & +230 Seedtaggers

2022 · Fundraising round of 250M€ + expansion into the U.S market

2023 · Expansion into 15 countries + 500 Seedtaggers

YOUR CHALLENGE
• Optimize efficiency towards operational excellence
• Improve the company’s profitability
• Increase client... satisfaction
• Drive business growth
• Supporting the VP Operations on executing the roadmap to optimize operational efficiency and achieve excellence across all channels and markets where we operate
• Pushing for consistent process improvement, thoroughly monitoring performance (KPIs) to proactively identify efficiency issues and propose solutions
• Understanding and leveraging commonalities and differences across markets, to keep an adequate balance of efficiency, standardization and localization
• Understanding our client needs, to challenge existing internal processes / design new processes that serve and delight our customers through successful delivery

YOU WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE IF
• You have 2+ years of experience in a similar role
• You have experience working in cross-functional / transformational projects (esp. process optimization), involving multiple teams and stakeholders to drive alignment and results
• You have exceptional strategic business analysis (both qualitative and quantitative) and are able to communicate to senior management in a concise and impactful manner
• You are able to manage several tasks and projects simultaneously, prioritizing effectively
• You enjoy solving problems and challenging the status quo
• You feel owner of your work and are able to work autonomously to drive results
• You have a growth mindset, are self-motivated and take initiative in everything you do
• You have a fluent level of Spanish and English

IT WOULD BE A BIG PLUS IF
• You have experience executing projects related to Target Operating Model and process optimization
• You have experience in the Digital / AdTech / Programmatic media environment

SEEDTAG PERKS

🚀 Key moment to join Seedtag in terms of growth and opportunities

💯 One Seedtag: Work for a month from any of our open offices with travel and stay paid if you’re a top performer

🍽️🚘 Access to a flexible benefits plan with restaurant, transportation, and kindergarten tickets and discounts

🏥 Health insurance included

🏋 Gympass, you will have access to wellness apps with certified psychologists, nutritional plans, on-demand classes and much more

🇬🇧 🇪🇸 🇫🇷 Optional company-paid English, Spanish and/or French courses.

📚 Odilo online school, where you can learn as much as you want.

⌛Real flexible schedule to balance work and personal life. You will be free to choose your work from home and office time with our hybrid style.

🍻 We love what we do, but we also love having fun. We have many team activities you can join and enjoy with your colleagues!

BENEFITS OF WORKING AT SEEDTAG
• Growth: International, highly demanding work environment in one of the fastest growing AdTech companies in Europe. We reject "that’s the way it’s always been done". In Seedtag you can find an energetic, fresh workplace, multicultural work environment where our members are from different countries in Europe, LATAM, the US and so many more!
• Impact: The chance to have a direct impact, here you don't work for the sake of working, we all have an impact on Seedtag in our own way, rowing in the same direction
• Diversity of methodology and people: Seedtag DNA is unique and highly appreciated by very different types of Seedtagers. We embrace diversity and encourage everyone to seek the best version of themselves and to show who they really are. With a totally flexible methodology
• Flexibility: At Seedtag, we trust you, you can work from home, the beach or the office in our hybrid mode

Are you ready to join the Seedtag adventure? Then send us your CV

jobs_results.title: HR Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Project Manager

Barcelona, Spain

Hybrid

Join our dynamic HR Effectiveness Monitoring Team as Project Manager, driving strategic initiatives, fostering a positive work culture while optimizing HR processes. Make an impact with your exceptional organizational and leadership skills while elevating our company to new heights!

At dsm-firmenich, being a force for good is not optional. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion is a shared responsibility woven into our daily work, benefiting to our People, Customers & Communities and driving business value. Equal access to opportunities is a given, belonging is a shared feeling, authenticity is celebrated.

Your key responsibilities
• Develop, lead and execute comprehensive project plans, defining objectives, scope, deliverables, timelines, and resources.
• Identify and mitigate risks associated with the project by implementing risk management strategies and monitoring progress.
• Actively engage stakeholders and build relationships, understanding... their needs and maintaining effective communication throughout the project.
• Provide direction and guidance to the project team, ensuring roles and responsibilities are clear, and fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
• Maintain accurate project documentation, including progress reports, meeting minutes, and relevant project records.
• Conduct Project Governance meetings to discuss project progress, address risks and issues, make strategic decisions, and ensure alignment with Project Sponsors and Program Team.

We bring
• A rich history and a promising future of bold scientific innovation and passionate creation with our customers;
• The opportunity to work for a company where sustainability is much more than a claim and is core to our strategy and purpose;
• A space to grow by encouraging and supporting curiosity and an open mindset;
• A flexible work environment that empowers people to take accountability for their work and own the outcome;
• Barrier-free communities within our organization where every employee is equally valued and respected – regardless of their background, beliefs, or identity;
• A firm belief that working together with our customers is the key to achieving great things;

You bring
• +5 years of experience managing and working in transformation programs and/or projects, ideally within the HR area.
• Experience working with different Shared Services Models.
• Familiar with data analytics and digital technologies to provide optimized data-driven solutions.
• Excellent communication skills.
• Experience in managing stakeholders at various levels at the organization and manage change.
• Ability to perform in a fast-moving environment.

• The opportunity to work for a company where sustainability is much more than a claim and is core to our strategy and purpose;
• A space to grow by encouraging and supporting curiosity and an open mindset;
• A flexible work environment that empowers people to take accountability for their work and own the outcome;
• Barrier-free communities within our organization where every employee is equally valued and respected – regardless of their background, beliefs, or identity;
• A firm belief that working together with our customers is the key to achieving great things;

You bring
• +5 years of experience managing and working in transformation programs and/or projects, ideally within the HR area.
• Experience working with different Shared Services Models.
• Familiar with data analytics and digital technologies to provide optimized data-driven solutions.
• Excellent communication skills.
• Experience in managing stakeholders at various levels at the organization and manage change.
• Ability to perform in a fast-moving environment.

jobs_results.title: Operations Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Hi, we’re Fever
We’re excited you are checking out this job offer.

We are the leading global live-entertainment discovery tech platform with a clear mission: to democratize access to culture and entertainment.

How do we achieve our mission? Fever has developed a proprietary technology that inspires a global community of over 125M people through personalized and curated experiences in their local city whilst empowering entertainment and event creators to reach new audiences and enhance their experience.

Sounds amazing, right?

About the team:

Having many products and countries, we need to make sure everything runs smoothly. As the Operations team, our goal is to help Fever grow, increasing the efficiency in our ways of working and maintaining a best-in-class experience for all our stakeholders. We love testing, launching and executing new projects, and supervise all Operations related topics, from events execution, user and partner operations to all processes and tools.

About the... role:

We are looking for an Operations Project Manager who loves to improve efficiency in everything and always finds the way to get things done!

This cross-functional role will allow you to interact with numerous areas of the business, understanding their needs and ways of working and giving you the opportunity to learn about how Fever works!.
• Lead and manage multiple strategic projects from initiation to completion, ensuring they align with defined goals, objectives, and timelines
• Collaborate with key stakeholders to identify project requirements, scope, and deliverables
• Monitor project progress, track key performance indicators, and provide regular updates to different stakeholders
• Identify potential project risks and issues, and develop proactive mitigation strategies to ensure project success
• Conduct post-project evaluations to identify lessons learned and areas for improvement

About you:
• + 3 years in a project management role or consulting background, with a successful track record of managing and delivering complex projects
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, business administration or a related field (or equivalent experience)
• Fluent English and Spanish. Other languages are a plus
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions
• Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and techniques

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs_results.title: Manager/Senior Manager PMO
jobs_results.description:
At ICON, it’s our people that set us apart. Our diverse teams enable us to become a better partner to our customers and help us to fulfil our mission to advance and improve patients’ lives.

Our ‘Own It’ culture is driven by four key values that bring us together as individuals and set us apart as an organisation: Accountability & Delivery, Collaboration, Partnership, and Integrity. We want to be the Clinical Research Organisation that delivers excellence to our clients and to patients at every touch-point. In short, to be the partner of choice in drug development.

That’s our vision. We’re driven by it. And we need talented people who share it.
If you’re as driven as we are, join us. You’ll be working in a dynamic and supportive environment, with some of the brightest and the friendliest people in the sector, and you’ll be helping shape an industry.

As a Manager/Senior Manager, Program Management Office, you will be part of the PMO group within Large Pharma. You will be adding value... through delivering successful support to the project management and clinical trial management groups as well as successfully delivering transformational change management projects and contributing to a culture of project group excellence.

The Role
• Deliver assigned change projects in collaboration with other services across ICON.
• Deliver change management initiatives ensuring on-time and within budget delivery.
• Deliver and support ICON University in training, onboarding, and upskilling programs within Large Pharma Program Management (IPH).
• Participate in periodic review and revision of IPH Program Management owned SOPs/ Policies/ Guidelines.
• Provide support in responding to process queries from Program Management group.
• May need to participate in process audit pertaining to IPH Program Management processes.
• May need to provide support in responding to RFI/RFPs.
• Performs additional relevant responsibilities as requested by management.

What You Need

• 3-5 years’ work experience within Project Management
• Have a Degree in a Life Sciences or related discipline.
• Customer focussed with the ability to build excellent rapport with business partners.
• Excellent knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint.
• Comfortable with presenting to groups.
• Super organised and remains calm in taking care of multiple priorities and working to tight deadlines.
• Passionate about developing a career within the PMO.
• Benefits of Working in ICON:
Our success depends on the knowledge, capabilities and quality of our people. That’s why we are committed to developing our employees in a continuous learning culture – one where we challenge you with engaging work and where every experience adds to your professional development.

At ICON, our focus is to provide you with a comprehensive and competitive total reward package that comprises, not only an excellent level of base pay, but also a wide range of variable pay and recognition programs. In addition, our best in class employee benefits, supportive policies and wellbeing initiatives are tailored to support you and your family at all stages of your career - both now, and into the future.

ICON, including subsidiaries, is an equal opportunity and inclusive employer and is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below.

#LI-JD122

#LI-Remote
